concerns.text: The plan assumes the pre‑trained Mask Diffusion Model can be run on a free‑tier GitHub Actions CPU runner (2 CPU cores, ~7 GB RAM) within 6 hours for 500 puzzles. In practice, diffusion models are orders of magnitude slower on CPU than GPU, making the 6‑hour bound unrealistic. Moreover, the fallback ‘GPU Escape Hatch’ (down‑sample to 50 puzzles and run on a free Kaggle GPU) violates the stated CPU‑only constraint and introduces a paid‑resource dependency, which is not permissible under the free‑compute policy.
